instructions.original_snippets: NEVER let a builder's build() compile with missing required fields
instructions.content: Never let a builder pattern's build() method compile before its required fields are set; track required-field state at the type level, not just at runtime.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER type an event emitter's emit/on with a loose string and any[]
instructions.content: Never type an event emitter's emit/on with a bare string event name and any[] payload; parameterize the emitter over an event map so each event's payload is checked against its name.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER leave a generic type parameter unconstrained when the pattern relies on it having a shape
instructions.content: Never leave a generic type parameter unconstrained when the pattern's logic assumes a shape; an unconstrained <T> degrades the pattern to any the moment a caller passes something unexpected.

instructions.original_snippets: Discriminated Unions: Use discriminated unions for states
instructions.content: Model a state machine's states as a discriminated union so each state only carries the fields valid for it, rather than a single class with many optional fields.

instructions.original_snippets: Exhaustive Checking: Use switch statements with never for exhaustive checking
instructions.content: Use a switch on the state's discriminant with a never-typed default branch when writing a state machine's transition function, so a new state added later is a compile error until handled.

instructions.original_snippets: Restrict an operation to only the state(s) where it's valid using Extract
instructions.content: When an operation is only valid for one member of a state union, type its parameter as that narrowed member (e.g. via Extract), not the whole union, so calling it with the wrong state is a compile error.
